searches.reason: Build evidence-based probes for the reported compatibility, unsupported equipment assumptions, and redundant replacements using only titles, descriptions, histories, and timestamps. Seek interpretable item-relation methods that distinguish complements from substitutes and explicitly abstain when information is insufficient; validate against qualitative judgments rather than inventing ownership or intent labels.
